items.label: TECTUM PANEL CEILING 2'x2' GRID SYSTEM at the accent-ceiling zone - metal edge molding, metal framing, over 5/8" gypsum board (detail 03/A510.2)
items.src: A510.2 detail 03 + A120; ID-1.6; finish schedule p.8
items.instanceNote: ⚑ System agrees, height does not - THREE printed values for the panel zone: A510.2 = 10'-0" accent zone (in a 9'-3" perimeter); A120 = 9'-6" panel field (in a 9'-3" surround); ID-1.6 = ACT-01 at 10'-2" for the whole room. OPEN_ITEMS C8 registers only the A510.2-vs-ID-1.6 pair - A120's 9'-6" is a third, unregistered value on a same-rev (08/09/24) architectural sheet. Code ACT-01 is printed on ID-1.6 and on finish-schedule card p.8 (Armstrong TECTUM Create!/Attach, area Fitness Center), which ties the ID tag to the architect's Tectum; the A-sheets themselves print 'TECTUM', not ACT-01. Panel-zone extent is not dimensioned (A120: only by inspection). A120 GC note: Tectum is a long-lead specialty item - confirm it is bought.

items.label: PAINTED GYP BOARD CEILING at the 9'-3" perimeter, surrounding the Tectum accent zone
items.instanceNote: ⚑ Both architect RCPs agree on a painted-gyp surround at 9'-3"; ID-1.6 instead shows the whole room as ACT-01 at 10'-2" with no gyp surround. A-series governs (ID-0.0 note 3), ID reading carried as the disagreement. Draft PT-07 line covers the ceiling PAINT only - this is the missing ceiling SYSTEM line.

PHONE MUST BE EQUIPPED WITH VOLUME CONTROL & A MIN. 28" LONG CORD. AN ACCESSIBLE ROUTE MUST BE PROVIDED TO THE EMERGENCY HOUSE PHONE WITH A CLEAR FLOOR SPACE @ THE PHONE.'
